title: MARK3 Launches Blue Streak Diamond Burs at Lower Prices
html:
Smarter Pricing. Comparable Performance. Maximum Value.

MARK3, a leader in high-quality yet cost-effective dental supplies, announces the launch of Blue Streak™ Diamond Burs, precision-engineered diamond burs that deliver fast, accurate cutting performance at one of the most competitive price points in dentistry today.

With quality comparable to premium dental bur brands—but at a significantly lower manufacturer’s suggested retail price (MSRP)—Blue Streak Diamond Burs redefine value without compromising clinical results.

Value That Speaks for Itself

Blue Streak Diamond Burs are designed for performance, durability, and smooth handling across a wide range of dental procedures, including shaping, contouring, and finishing. Each bur features:

  • Advanced diamond exposure for efficient cutting
  • High-security bonding technology that locks diamonds to the shank and tip for lasting life and consistent performance
  • Precision-manufactured balance and control for predictable clinical outcomes

Whether preparing a restoration or refining margins, Blue Streak Diamond Burs deliver reliable performance practice after practice.

Below is a snapshot of current competitor pricing for similar diamond bur packs, showing how Blue Streak compares in value:

Pricing varies by shape, grit, and vendor but reflects typical MSRP ranges for retail and professional dental suppliers.

This pricing demonstrates how Blue Streak offers comparable utility and performance features at a substantial cost advantage, making the burs a compelling choice for modern practices focused on both quality and operational efficiency.

Compare With the Best

Blue Streak Diamond Burs are designed to compare directly with leading brands clinicians trust, including:

  • Midwest®
  • Neo Diamond®
  • Two Striper®
  • Brasseler®

These brands are known for high performance and professional reliability, yet typically carry higher MSRP pricing per pack of equivalent burs. With MARK3 Blue Streak, practices gain similar quality expectations at a significantly better price point.

Value That Improves Practice Economics

While a typical 5-pack from many competitors retails for approximately $43 to $145 or more, Blue Streak Diamond Burs start as low as $21.95, offering:

  • Lower cost per bur
  • Lower cost per procedure
  • Optimal cutting performance and longevity

“Dentists deserve high-quality tools that don’t force them to compromise on price,” said a MARK3 spokesperson. “Blue Streak Diamond Burs are about delivering that choice—premium performance without premium pricing.”

Availability

Blue Streak Diamond Burs are now available at Cargus.com and through select authorized distributors.

Learn more and order today: https://www.cargus.com/blue-streak-diamond-burs.
